notes.title: Version 1.8 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes/Minor Patches[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed interaction that would play two lines of dialogue at the same time.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes/Minor Patches[/h2]

[list]
[*]Removed a way to get out of bounds near the end of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.6 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes/Minor Patches[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed intro splash screen displaying incorrectly if running on Linux/Steam Deck.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.5 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes/Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added full support for PlayStation controllers.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now switch between keyboard + mouse and gamepad controls without having to disconnect the gamepad.  Simply give input on your keyboard + mouse or gamepad and the game will dynamically switch to accept input from the last used method.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes/Minor Patches[/h2]
[list]
[*]An obscure interaction that could cause loss of keyboard + mouse input has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.3 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now close the manual using the enter, return, and space keys.
[*] The message that displays when quitting the game from the pause menu now reflects the time since last save even after full power loss.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes/Minor Patches[/h2]
[list]
[*] The full screen setting is now properly maintained if switching the monitor being played on.
[*] The carrier no longer appears if resuming a saved game from the first generator.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes/Minor Patches[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that would lock some of the vehicle's buttons and levers in the first crevice.
[*]Fixed an error with some text.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Your on-board navigational AI always provides helpful advice.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added ability to set field of view via the options menu
[*]Levers can now be moved with the left joystick on controllers
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes/Minor Patches[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug causing a certain event to only occur if you had never fully lost power
[*]Fixed rare bug in which music from the start of the game played during a later sequence
[*]Fixed minor graphical error in menus if pressing controller buttons during fade transitions
[*]You can no longer accidentally remove the crosshair when playing with a controller
[*]Navigating through some tighter areas is a bit fairer
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some world events are a bit more subtle... Is that your imagination just getting the better of you?
[*]The wasteland holds more to be discovered
[/list]
